status.message: {status, select, healthy {Healthy} degraded {Degraded} down {Down} sandbox {Sandbox} warming_up {Warming up} paused {Paused} other {{raw}}}
status.note: a sending provider's status, on its account health card

name.selfHosted.note: a self-hosted provider's name (Postal), never translated

rate.spamComplaint.note: Postmark's name for its complaint rate

threshold.reviewPause.note: SES's own enforcement levels: it reviews the account above the first rate and pauses it above the second

threshold.warmupGuard.note: the warm-up planner's limit while a provider warms up

threshold.guard.note: the limit ReputeCast sets for a self-hosted provider

note.reputationDashboard.note: SES's reputation dashboard, on its account health card

note.vdmOff.message: Bounce and complaint metrics only; no VDM

note.vdmOn.note: Virtual Deliverability Manager is SES's name, never translated

note.streamNone.note: kind: Postmark's stream type, Broadcast or Transactional, never translated

stream.name.message: {stream, select, broadcast {Broadcast} automation {Automation} system {System} transactional {Transactional} other {{raw}}}
stream.name.note: ReputeCast's streams, in a provider's note

note.thresholdsValue: Set by ReputeCast; {name} has no account limits

link.warmup.note: a link after an incident of the timeline

delisting.pending.note: added after a listing incident; date: the day it was requested (8 Oct)

peak.migration.note: explains the Gmail spam rate's peak: the first send after moving to ReputeCast

listing.title.note: asset: a domain or IP; source: a blocklist's name, never translated

listing.detail: Found by the built-in daily check ({impact, select, high {high} medium {medium} other {low}} impact).
listing.body: Found by the built-in daily check ({impact, select, high {high} medium {medium} other {low}} impact). Delisting page: {url}

reason.stale.message: HostRepute data can't be refreshed: reconnect HostRepute or wait for the built-in check.
reason.stale.note: why the blocklist check of Send Readiness is unknown

reason.rejected.message: HostRepute rejected the token on {at, date}; reconnect to resume blocklist checks.
reason.rejected.note: at: the day HostRepute rejected it

reason.none: No blocklist check has run yet.
problem.notListed: {asset} isn't listed on any blocklist we check.
problem.delistViaHostRepute: Delisting requests go through HostRepute. Request it on the list's own page instead: {url}
problem.ip: Give an IPv4 or IPv6 address.
problem.chooseReport: Choose a DMARC aggregate report: an .xml file, or the .xml.gz or .zip a mailbox provider sent.
problem.zipNoXML: The zip file has no .xml report.
problem.tooLarge: The report is larger than {mb, number} MB.

problem.notDMARC.message: This isn't a DMARC aggregate report: {error}.
problem.notDMARC.note: error: why the XML couldn't be read, in English

problem.notDMARCEmpty: This isn't a DMARC aggregate report: no report_metadata or records.
problem.notSendingDomain: This report is for {domain}, which isn't a sending domain of this workspace.

label.unknownSource.note: a DMARC report's sending source that isn't one of the workspace's providers

run.unanswered.message: {failed} of {total} lookups didn't answer; they show as unknown.
run.unanswered.note: after a built-in blocklist check: DNS lookups of the blocklists that gave no answer

run.stopped.note: why a Deliverability check run failed
